_about: INPUT, hand-transcribed from SchwingNet/results/spineps_ids/TS12_VERIFY.md (F1, 2026-09-23; grid job 40424902, tool tools/ts12_verify_ids.py). The verified subtype of each of the 12 TotalSegmentator bench cases that tools/anomalous_inventory.py once selected by 'SPINEPS mask id 25 present'. Read by tools/anomalous_inventory.py --ts-override and tools/transitional_subtypes.py --ts-override; both refuse a TotalSegmentator case this file does not name.

chain.mask_id_call: id 25 present in ~/bench_ts/spineps/native/TS_<s>_seg-vert_msk.nii.gz. WRONG: those ids are a raw 1..N enumeration of instances, so 'id 25 present' meant 'at least 25 instances' (whole-spine fields of view), never L6.
chain.veridah_ctd_call: VERIDAH's ordered naming from the ctd json beside each mask (SchwingNet/results/rare_class/ts12_ctd_subtypes.json). Model output: it skipped T12 in s1178 and names a rib-less 20th vertebra T13 in s1088/s1123.
chain.verified_subtype: F1's independent count, which uses no VERIDAH name: SPINEPS instances as objects in S-I order, TotalSegmentator objects of the same CT, and rib components found in the CT itself (HU >= 200 outside every TS label except the ribs), decided on the renders (axial slabs at each transverse-process level, mid-sagittal lumbosacral slices).

convention: The project's written definitions (docs/STUDENT_FLUORO_CORRECTION_GUIDE.md): L6 = six lumbar-type (rib-free, mobile) vertebrae between the last rib-bearing vertebra and the sacrum; T13 = thirteen rib-bearing vertebrae. Under them a spine with 12 rib pairs and a rib-less 20th vertebra is L6-pattern, whatever VERIDAH calls that vertebra. verified_subtype follows this convention; veridah_ctd_call is kept beside it so the other reading is never lost.
not_known: No radiologist has read any of the twelve. s1171: the CT stops about 10 mm into the bone below L5, so fused S1 versus a free 25th vertebra cannot be read. s1178: osteopenic and scoliotic; whether its lowest vertebra is free was not read with confidence (at most 5 lumbar-type remain, so it cannot be L6). s0224, s1380: an S1-S2 remnant line on one mid-sagittal slice; the alae were not checked, so a lumbarised S1 (a 25-presacral spine) is unlikely but not excluded.

TS_s0224.caveat: S1 shows an S1-S2 remnant line on the mid-sagittal slice; alae not checked

TS_s0616.evidence: 7/13/5; ribs meet #20's transverse processes on both sides (TS_s0616_axial_tp.png); CT rib components on #20 L+R, 883/920 voxels; L5 free, S1 fused

TS_s1088.evidence: 7/12/6; ribs #8..#19 (T12); #20 (VERIDAH 'T13') has no rib either side at body or TP level (TS_s1088_axial_tp.png); its TPs are short and thoracic-type, #21's long and lumbar; L5 free, FOV ends in the lower sacrum
TS_s1088.caveat: rib-less 20th vertebra with thoracic-type transverse processes: T13 by VERIDAH's morphological naming, L6-pattern by the rib convention

TS_s1089.evidence: 7/12/6; ribs #8..#19 (T12); L6 free with a disc above and below, sacrum fused below it (TS_s1089_ls.png)

TS_s1123.evidence: 7/12/6; ribs #8..#19 (T12); #20 (VERIDAH 'T13') has no articulating rib, short TPs; a 202-voxel left nubbin is the size of the non-rib fragments seen at L1/L2 in normal spines (TS_s1123_axial_tp.png); L5 free (thin disc below), FOV stops about 10 mm into the sacrum (TS_s1123_ls.png)
TS_s1123.caveat: rib-less 20th vertebra with thoracic-type transverse processes: T13 by VERIDAH's morphological naming, L6-pattern by the rib convention

TS_s1171.evidence: 7/12/5 seen; ribs #8..#19 (T12); L5 has a disc below
TS_s1171.caveat: field-of-view-limited: the CT stops about 10 mm into the next bone, so S1 versus a free 25th vertebra cannot be read

TS_s1178.evidence: 7/12/5; the 12th ribs meet #19, which VERIDAH calls 'L1' (TS_s1178_axial.png); #20 has no rib; the ctd has no T12, so VERIDAH's L1..L6 are T12, L1..L5
TS_s1178.caveat: severe thoracolumbar scoliosis, osteopenic; lowest vertebra not read with confidence, which cannot make it L6 (at most 5 lumbar-type remain)

TS_s1304.evidence: 7/12/5; ribs #8..#19 (T12); L5 free (disc); the S1 remnant line widens into the alae on the coronal, so it is sacral

TS_s1380.evidence: 7/12/5; ribs #8..#19 (T12); L5 free on the slice (weak HU disc contrast, osteopenic)
TS_s1380.caveat: S1 shows an S1-S2 remnant line; alae not checked
